I’m not able to pull live exchange‑rate data right now, but as a rough guide:

* 1 USD ≈ 0.78 GBP (this has been close to the market rate over the past few weeks).  
* So $20 × 0.78 ≈ £15.60.

Keep in mind that rates change constantly, so the exact amount you’ll receive will depend on the day you make the transfer and any fees your bank or service may charge. For the most accurate figure, check a trusted financial news site, your bank’s website, or a currency‑conversion app at the time of your transaction.
